doc.columns: describes the count and the size of the grid's columns, see [GridCells] doc for more information
doc.modifier: the modifier to apply to this layout
doc.state: the state object to be used to control or observe the list's state
doc.contentPadding: specify a padding around the whole content
doc.reverseLayout: reverse the direction of scrolling and layout. When `true`, items will be laid out in the reverse order and [LazyGridState.firstVisibleItemIndex] == 0 means that grid is scrolled to the bottom. Note that [reverseLayout] does not change the behavior of [verticalArrangement], e.g. with [Arrangement.Top] (top) 123### (bottom) becomes (top) 321### (bottom).
doc.verticalArrangement: The vertical arrangement of the layout's children
doc.horizontalArrangement: The horizontal arrangement of the layout's children
doc.userScrollEnabled: whether the scrolling via the user gestures or accessibility actions is allowed. You can still scroll programmatically using the state even when it is disabled.
doc.overscrollEffect: the [OverscrollEffect] that will be used to render overscroll for this layout. Note that the [OverscrollEffect.node] will be applied internally as well - you do not need to use Modifier.overscroll separately.
